evidence: Clicking "API" filter reduced list to 5 API docs; clicking "All" restored all 19 documents.
Selecting "REST API Design Guidelines" shows title, description, date 2024-01-15, version v2.3.0, 3 content sections, and 4 related documents.
Clicking "API Versioning Strategy" link inside expanded "REST Principles" section navigated the document view to that document.

Clicking expanded "Versioning Approaches" header hid its paragraph body; the reference link changed from a clickable pointer-cursor button to a non-pointer muted chip, and chevron lost rotate-180 class. Section header remained clickable to reopen.
Clicking the collapsed "Versioning Approaches" header again restored its paragraph body and the "REST API Guidelines" reference link as a clickable (cursor=pointer) button.
Section header chevron icon has "rotate-180" class when expanded (body/links visible) and no rotation when collapsed (body/links hidden) — indicator state agrees with visibility.

Clicking "REST API Guidelines" link while its section was collapsed kept document unchanged and showed toast "Please expand the section to access links". After expanding, clicking the same link navigated to "REST API Design Guidelines".
Clicking a graph node added a glow halo and increased stroke-width (visible selection indicator). Zoom In changed 100%→120% label; Reset View restored 100%.

issue: Node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking a document node in the Knowledge Graph (via real Playwright click and also via synthetic click/dblclick dispatch) only applies a visual selection highlight (glow + thicker stroke) to the node. It does not open the document in the Document view, does not switch tabs, and no document detail panel appears anywhere on the page (verified via full DOM text dump showing no document content).

evidence: Graph renders exactly 19 nodes (.graph-node) matching all 19 documents, with 19 relationship lines. Zoom In/Zoom Out/Reset View controls change zoom (100%→120%/80%→100%) allowing the graph to be scaled to fit view.

19 graph nodes correspond 1:1 to the 19 documents; node fill color hsl(187,85%,53%) for API-module doc matches the "API" legend swatch rgb(33,213,237); 19 connection lines drawn between related nodes.
Nav bar has Documents, Knowledge Graph, Favorites buttons; clicking each switches the active view (Favorites shown active and rendering distinct "No favorites yet" content).

Selected document "API Versioning Strategy" and expanded "Versioning Approaches" section remained intact when switching Documents→Favorites→Documents. Graph zoom set to 140% persisted after switching Knowledge Graph→Documents→Knowledge Graph.

issue: Favorites view is filtered by the Documents module filter
actual: Favoriting worked (2 docs), the Favorites nav badge updated immediately to "2" and persisted "2" after a full page reload, and favorite markers survived sorting by Module and filtering by "UI" module in Documents. However, when a module filter (e.g. "API") was active in Documents and had no overlap with the favorited documents (Accessibility Standards/UI, API Key Management/Core System), switching to the Favorites tab showed "No favorites yet" instead of listing both favorited documents — the Favorites view is incorrectly scoped by the Documents module filter rather than exposing every favorited document regardless of it.

evidence: Sampled documents across all 5 modules (REST API Design Guidelines, API Versioning Strategy, JWT Authentication, Component Library, Query Optimization) — in each case neither the "Related Documents" list nor the content-section reference chips include the document itself.

Searching "zzzznonexistentquery" displayed a clear "No documents found" heading with "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria" message. Clearing the search box restored the full document list (all 19 documents across API, Auth, Core, Data, UI modules).
